supersedes.reason: E2 review round 1, B1: dash, Ubuntu’s /bin/sh, reads `kill -KILL -- -<group>` as a pid and signals nothing, so the anchored group kill became `kill -s KILL -- "-$ORACLE_GROUP"`, the exported ORACLE_GROUP_KILL; the replacement removes that same call over the new line, and the same named test kills it.
